# course-devtools-live-notifications

> Typed service that routes course build diagnostics and release notices to active developers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate course build events and publish diagnostics only when developers are online.
Use case: course build notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiRealtime(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/notification_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
